title: Module 1 Consolidation & Early Supplement Iʿrāb
source: Original synthesis lesson authored for this application (syllabus ref: Haywood & Nahmad Ch. 1–13 & Literary Supplement p. 462; Ryding Ch. 1–10, 12–13, 21–22)
objectives: Apply the Daily 3-Step Textual Iʿrāb Routine to unvocalized nominal and verbal sentences.
Verify every case ending (rafʿ, naṣb, jarr) and name its governing factor (ʿāmil).
Consolidate Chapters 1–13 before transitioning to the imperfect verbal system in Module 2.
recallPrompt: What are the three steps of the Daily Textual Iʿrāb Routine?

sections.heading: Transitioning Beyond Transliteration
sections.body: Chapters 1–13 establish the complete foundation of Arabic nominal syntax, case inflection, annexation, pronouns, and the Form I past verb. From Module 2 onward, phonetic transliteration is minimized so you read directly from fully vowelled Classical Arabic script.

sections.label: Module 1 Iʿrāb Checklist
sections.summary: For every clause: (1) Classify as Nominal (Ismiyyah) or Verbal (Fiʿliyyah); (2) Locate Mubtadaʾ + Khabar (checking for kāna) or Fiʿl + Fāʿil + Mafʿūl Bihi; (3) Justify every case ending via its ʿāmil (default rafʿ, preposition/iḍāfah → jarr, object/khabar kāna → naṣb).

sections.arabic: قَرَأَ الطَّالِبُ كِتَابَ التَّارِيخِ فِي المَكْتَبَةِ
sections.transliteration: qaraʾa ṭ-ṭālibu kitāba t-tārīkhi fī l-maktabati
sections.translation: The student read the book of history in the library.
sections.irab: قَرَأَ: فِعْلٌ مَاضٍ | الطَّالِبُ: فَاعِلٌ مَرْفُوعٌ | كِتَابَ: مَفْعُولٌ بِهِ مَنْصُوبٌ وَهُوَ مُضَافٌ | التَّارِيخِ: مُضَافٌ إِلَيْهِ مَجْرُورٌ | فِي المَكْتَبَةِ: جَارٌّ وَمَجْرُورٌ
sections.notes: Notice how كِتَابَ is both the direct object (accusative) AND the muḍāf of an iḍāfah (no al-, no tanwīn).

sections.heading: Module 1 Checkpoint
sections.body: Before starting Week 9 (The Imperfect System), make sure you can vocalize unvowelled nominal sentences, iḍāfah chains, and kāna predicates without guessing.
